definition_en: Not having official permission to be in a place or do something.
example_en: Unauthorized access to the building is strictly prohibited by security staff.
example_uz: Binoga ruxsatsiz kirish qo'riqlash xizmati tomonidan qat'iyan man etiladi.

definition_en: A substance in the body that fights against diseases and harmful germs.
example_en: The body creates an antibody to fight against the new virus.
example_uz: Tana yangi virusga qarshi kurashish uchun antitanacha ishlab chiqaradi.

definition_en: Having the necessary skill or ability to do a job well.
example_en: She is a competent manager who handles all tasks with great care.
example_uz: U barcha vazifalarni katta e'tibor bilan bajaradigan malakali menejer.

definition_en: A flat part of a fish's body used for swimming or balancing.
example_en: The shark moved its fin to turn quickly in the water.
example_uz: Akula suvda tez burilish uchun suzgichini harakatlantirdi.

definition_en: A leader or official who guides a group of people in their church.
example_en: The local pastor gave a long speech at the Sunday morning service.
example_uz: Mahalliy ruhoniy yakshanba tonggi marosimida uzoq nutq so'zladi.

definition_en: Soft, wet earth that is created when rain falls on ground.
example_en: The kids played in the mud after the heavy rain stopped.
example_uz: Kuchli yomg'ir to'xtagach, bolalar loyda o'ynashdi.
